comment: GAPS live-gate decks (GAPS_PLAN.md): synthesized decks for every feature deferred in Phases 4-7 only because no vendored corpus deck exercises it. Same live-compare mandate as the controls family (full model + probes / compare_eventlog / compare_ctrlqueue / check_meters_monitors, run by a gaps_cases_match_oracle added at GAPS_PLAN execution). Every case starts with pending=true (the feature is NOT_PORTED; the Rust engine must error loudly, never silently fall back); the WP that ports the feature flips its cases to pending=false and they join the live compare. WPG.14 asserts no pending=true remains. All decks were validated on the pinned oracle 2026-07-05: deterministic across two separate oracle processes (see GAPS_PLAN.md section 2.1 for why that matters) and feature-sensitive. n_steps = solve sample points observed on the oracle. Binary/CSV fixtures (ls8.sng, ls8.dbl, lspq8.csv, t8.sng, p8.dbl, g4.csv) regenerate via tools/corpus/gen_gaps_binshapes.py.

cases.note: Oracle segfaults at PROCESS EXIT after an AutoAdd solve (solve itself completes; Text.Result = 'b3, 0.0180069930672805', Generator.gadd1 appended, fingerprint bit-identical across runs). The oracle-side driver must capture everything before interpreter teardown; see GAPS_PLAN.md section 2.2.
Harmonics case: the second Solve sweeps harmonics 1/5/7 (3 monitor samples). Feature-sensitive probe-proven: removing rcurve/lcurve shifts the harmonic monitor channels ~0.6%.
ControlModel accepts only the ordinal (ControlModel=1); the enum name is rejected by the upstream text parser (probe-proven).
Feature-sensitive probe-proven: with Set SeasonRating=no the event log diverges from hour 12 (the 500 kW season target never engages). Option spelling is 'Set SeasonRating', not 'SeasonalRating'.
